paragraphs.text: Kinymu is a Jamuraan city-state that forms part of the Kipamu League . Situated about a hundred leagues inland from the sea, Kinymu contributed troops and resources to the League’s efforts to defend Jamuraa against the invading Keldon forces during the Prophecy War .

When the renowned mage Barrin arrived to inspect the combined forces of Kinymu and Arsenal City , he found Mageta serving as the army’s commanding officer. Despite Barrin’s intervention and leadership, the Kipamu League’s army, including Kinymu’s contingent, ultimately suffered defeat at the hands of the Keldons - though the Keldons later withdrew from Jamuraa shortly before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .

Kinymu is also remembered for the story behind the seashell cameo , made after a seashell fell from the empty sky in Kinymu, a hundred leagues from the sea. It was found by the master carver Isel , who was torn between carving a woman or a bird inside the shell. In the end, Isel carved both — carving the inside of the fallen shell with the shape of an angel - a bit of both woman and bird.
